subject: Approval request: AngloHealth case study & logo use
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@anglohealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request to feature AngloHealth in Redwood case study + logo use

Hi Sanjay —

Hope you're well. We finished a draft of the case study we discussed at last week's call and would love to feature AngloHealth as a customer story on our site and in an upcoming webinar. The draft pulls a short quote from the transcript and includes a one-page visual for marketing (PDF attached).

Would AngloHealth be comfortable with:
- Redwood publishing the case study on redwood.ai and in our sales materials
- Using the AngloHealth name and logo (we will follow brand guidelines)
- Quoting the short excerpt shown on page 2 (we can tweak wording)

Attachments: case_study_draft.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB); logo_usage_guidelines.pdf (PDF, 300KB)

If this looks generally OK, can you route to legal for a formal OK and, if possible, send a high-res logo (SVG preferred)? We can provide a short release for signature if needed.

Thanks — we appreciate the partnership and want to make sure we respect your brand & legal process.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@anglohealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: AngloHealth Legal <legal@anglohealth.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Feb 2026 14:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to feature AngloHealth in Redwood case study + logo use

Hi Priya —

Thanks for sending the draft. Nice work — the narrative captures the flow of our project. AngloHealth is open to being featured, but we will need sign-off from our legal team on quote wording and a short trademark/license clause before you publish.

Two small requests from product/marketing: please remove the line that mentions specific patient throughput numbers (we treat those as internal metrics), and adjust the quote on page 2 to: "Redwood Inference helped us cut inference latency by meaningful margins, improving system responsiveness for clinicians."

I have looped in AngloHealth Legal (legal@anglohealth.com) and attached our brand guidelines for reference. We'll get back with a formal confirmation within 10 business days.

Attachments: anglohealth_brand_guidelines_v2.pdf (PDF, 540KB)

— Sanjay Rao
Head of Product, AngloHealth
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: AngloHealth Legal <legal@anglohealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request to feature AngloHealth — legal/comms review requested

Laura / Legal team —

Forwarding AngloHealth's note. They asked to remove the patient throughput line and to tweak the short quote; we made the edit inline in the attached draft (redline on page 2). Can you review the attached redline and advise on the following:
1) Do we need a formal trademark use clause in the release? If so, please propose wording (term length, permitted uses).
2) Are there any publicity restrictions or disclosures we should add (e.g., not implying endorsement for regulatory claims)?
3) Recommend whether a DocuSign release is sufficient or if AngloHealth needs a separate master agreement amendment.

CC Stephanie from Marketing — once Legal confirms, we'll send Anglo a final release and request high-res logo.

Attachments: case_study_draft_redline.pdf (PDF, 1.3MB)

Thanks —
Priya
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, AngloHealth Legal <legal@anglohealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Feb 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request to feature AngloHealth — legal/comms review requested

Priya —

Reviewed the redline. Legal is comfortable with publication subject to the following additions to the release:
- A limited trademark license granting Redwood the right to use AngloHealth's name and logo for marketing and promotional materials for a period of 3 years from the date of written approval.
- A clause stating Redwood will not attribute any clinical claims to AngloHealth beyond the facts in the case study; remove any patient-level metrics (done).
- Standard indemnity language limited to willful misconduct; no broader warranties.

Suggested release text (you can paste this into the DocuSign): 
"AngloHealth grants Redwood Inference a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use AngloHealth's name and logo solely for marketing and promotional materials promoting Redwood's products and services, for a period of three (3) years from the date of AngloHealth's written approval. AngloHealth represents that the materials do not disclose protected patient information and authorizes Redwood to publish the agreed-upon quote."

I attached a redline with the proposed release language. If AngloHealth legal agrees to this language, we can send a DocuSign envelope for signature.

Attachments: legal_release_redline.pdf (PDF, 45KB)

— Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@anglohealth.com>, AngloHealth Legal <legal@anglohealth.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request to feature AngloHealth — marketing visuals and timeline

Hi Sanjay / team —

Thanks for the feedback. From marketing's side, once legal OKs the release we'll do the following:
- Publish the final case study PDF on redwood.ai/case-studies and include a one-slide visual in our sales deck.
- Share a short social post and one LinkedIn author post tagging AngloHealth (we will send copy for pre-approval).
- We will never publish patient-level numbers; visuals will use aggregated, anonymized metrics.

Action items for AngloHealth: please confirm final high-res logo (SVG) and preferred brand color usage (we'll follow your guidelines). If you prefer DocuSign, here's the link to the release draft: https://app.docusign.com/envelopes/E-ABC1234

If Anglo confirms by Feb 18 we aim to publish the week of Feb 23 and run the social post the following week.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com

Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Approval: case study & logo use — AngloHealth (signed)

Hello Priya / Redwood team —

AngloHealth confirms approval of the final case study draft and the adjusted quote. We agree to the limited trademark license as proposed by Redwood's counsel, for three (3) years from the date of this email (i.e., through 2029-02-15). This email and the attached signed release constitute AngloHealth's written permission to use the AngloHealth name and logo in the agreed-upon materials.

Please note: usage must comply with the attached brand guidelines and may not imply endorsement of clinical outcomes beyond language in the case study.

Attachments: signed_brand_release.pdf (PDF, 15KB); anglo_logo_master.svg (SVG, 150KB)

Regards —
